atoms.title: WikiHop support 02

atoms.title: WikiHop support 02
atoms.sentence: Official designation as a trauma center is determined by individual state law provisions .

atoms.title: WikiHop support 02
atoms.sentence: Trauma centers vary in their specific capabilities and are identified by `` Level '' designation : Level - I ( Level - 1 ) being the highest , to Level - III ( Level - 3 ) being the lowest ( some states have five designated levels , in which case Level - V ( Level - 5 ) is the lowest ) .

atoms.title: WikiHop support 02

atoms.title: WikiHop support 02

atoms.title: WikiHop support 02

atoms.sentence: As leader of the Socialist Party, he was the first figure from the left elected president under the Fifth Republic.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 15
atoms.sentence: It includes 16 constituent states, covers an area of , and has a largely temperate seasonal climate.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 15
atoms.sentence: With about 82 million inhabitants, Germany is the most populous member state of the European Union.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 15
atoms.sentence: After the United States, it is the second most popular immigration destination in the world.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 15
atoms.sentence: Germany's capital and largest metropolis is Berlin.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 15
atoms.sentence: Other major cities include Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart and Düsseldorf.

atoms.sentence: Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a federal republic in Europe.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 16
atoms.sentence: It consists of 26 cantons, and the city of Bern is the seat of the federal authorities.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 16
atoms.sentence: The country is situated in Western-Central Europe, and is bordered by Italy to the south, France to the west, Germany to the north, and Austria and Liechtenstein to the east.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 16
atoms.sentence: Switzerland is a landlocked country geographically divided between the Alps, the Swiss Plateau and the Jura, spanning an area of .

atoms.title: WikiHop support 16
atoms.sentence: While the Alps occupy the greater part of the territory, the Swiss population of approximately eight million people is concentrated mostly on the plateau, where the largest cities are to be found: among them are the two global cities and economic centres Zürich and Geneva.

atoms.sentence: Pierre Mauroy (5 July 1928  7 June 2013) was a French Socialist politician who was Prime Minister of France from 1981 to 1984 under President François Mitterrand.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 17
atoms.sentence: Mauroy also served as Mayor of Lille from 1973 to 2001.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 17
atoms.sentence: At the time of his death Mauroy was the emeritus mayor of the city of Lille.

atoms.title: WikiHop support 17
atoms.sentence: He died from complications of lung cancer on June 7, 2013 at the age of 84.
